jobs.description:
Job Description

What is the opportunity?

Lead strategic innovation and operational excellence across RBC Insurance's digital assets. As Senior Director, Digital Channels, you'll own end-to-end strategy and delivery across our digital ecosystem, from Online Insurance platforms built on RBC's proprietary tech stack to Advisor Portals powered by Salesforce.

In this pivotal role, you'll serve as the central point of accountability for optimizing digital touchpoints that drive customer engagement and advisor productivity. You'll collaborate seamlessly with Technology, Business, Digital & Data, Operations, and Product teams to execute high-impact initiatives that deliver operational excellence and measurable business results.

This is an opportunity to shape how RBC Insurance connects with customers and advisors in the digital age.

What will you do?

Shape the digital vision: Drive the multi-year strategy and roadmap for Online Insurance and Advisor Portal platforms, ensuring every initiative drives organizational priorities forward
Champion client-first digital innovation: Lead a disciplined approach to understanding client needs and translating them into platform capabilities. Drive accountability for user experience metrics and ensure every digital initiative measurably improves client satisfaction and engagement.
Deliver at scale: Lead end-to-end execution of digital channel initiatives across RBC's proprietary tech stack and Salesforce environments, translating strategic vision into executable roadmaps and quarterly milestones
Own financial accountability: Develop, manage, and optimize operational budgets and delivery financial plans to ensure cost-effective, timely execution without compromising quality
Drive accountability through data and transparency: Establish and monitor delivery performance metrics, KPIs, and transparent status reporting that enable informed decision-making
Build lasting partnerships: Serve as the trusted delivery partner to business stakeholders, cultivating strong relationships across Digital Channels, Product, and Business Operations to align priorities and remove obstacles
Translate impact into narrative: Communicate digital platform progress through compelling storytelling that connects technical achievements to measurable business value and customer outcomes
Lead and inspire teams: Provide strategic leadership to developers, engineers, and technical specialists, building a high-performance culture of collaboration. Coach technical leaders on delivery excellence, strategic thinking, and career development
Champion continuous learning: Cultivate a team of technical thought leaders who stay at the forefront of industry trends, emerging technologies, and digital platform best practices, ensuring RBC Insurance maintains competitive advantage and drives innovation across digital channels.

What do you need to succeed?

Must Have

10+ years of progressive leadership in digital delivery, platform engineering, or technology transformation, with 5+ years leading technical teams delivering enterprise-scale IT solutions
Experience leading AI driven innovation across digital channels, including both implementing AI solutions and championing AI driven development.
Skilled in leveraging AI and emerging technologies to enhance platform capabilities, drive innovation, and optimize delivery outcomes
Deep expertise across technology landscapes. Proficient in both legacy and modern tech stacks (RBC ecosystem and Salesforce), with strong understanding of integration, orchestration, and hybrid technology ecosystems
Demonstrated track record delivering complex digital solutions at enterprise scale within financial institutions or regulated industries
Ability to lead diverse teams and influence senior stakeholders through data-driven decision-making, executive communication, and strong facilitation skills
Strong foundation in software development lifecycle, API management, data flows, budgeting, and resource allocation to drive cost-effective delivery

Nice to Have

10+ years of progressive leadership experience in digital delivery, platform engineering, or technology transformation; 5+ years leading technical teams delivering IT solutions
Proven experience delivering complex digital solutions at enterprise scale within financial institutions or regulated industries
Expertise in both legacy and modern tech stacks (RBC technology ecosystem and Salesforce platforms); Deep understanding of integration, orchestration, and hybrid technology
Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams and influence senior stakeholders through data-driven decision-making; Superior executive-level communication, presentation, and facilitation skills

What’s in it for you?

We thrive on the challenge to be our best, progressive thinking to keep growing, and working together to deliver trusted advice to help our clients thrive and communities prosper. We care about each other, reaching our potential, making a difference to our communities, and achieving success that is mutual.

A comprehensive Total Rewards Program including bonuses and flexible benefits, competitive compensation, commissions, and stock where applicable
Leaders who support your development through coaching and managing opportunities
Ability to make a difference and lasting impact
Work in a dynamic, collaborative, progressive, and high-performing team
A world-class training program in financial services
Opportunities to do challenging work
Opportunities to take on progressively greater accountabilities
Opportunities to build close relationships with clients
Access to a variety of job opportunities across business and geographies.

jobs.title: Interim Vice President, Finance, Technology & Business Operations
jobs.description:
IMMEDIATE INTERIM OPPORTUNITY

Interim Vice President, Finance, Technology & Business Operations

Reports To: Chief Executive Officer

Duration: 3 to 6 months

Location: Greater Toronto Area

Hybrid Working

Our client is a respected national not-for-profit organization with a complex operating model, multiple stakeholders and a strong mission-driven culture. The organization works collaboratively with regional partners and relies on effective financial stewardship, technology, data, risk management and business operations to deliver on its mandate.

The Opportunity

The organization is seeking an experienced interim executive to provide transitional leadership following an unexpected leave. This is a three-to-six-month assignment combining hands-on operational oversight with strategic advice and support to the CEO.

The Interim Vice President will inherit a capable, well-performing team across finance and technology. The priority is not to initiate unnecessary change, but to provide stability, sound judgment and thoughtful leadership through a delicate period of transition. The successful interim will maintain operational continuity, coach and support the team, and ensure that the CEO and executive leadership have the financial information, analytics and technology advice required for effective decision-making.

The portfolio includes responsibility for finance and technology/information services, with broader involvement in business operations, risk and organizational planning.

Transitional and Operational Leadership

Provide steady, visible and reassuring leadership during a sensitive period of transition.
Assume day-to-day executive accountability for finance, technology and related business operations.
Maintain momentum on existing priorities while ensuring continuity of critical services, reporting and controls.
Quickly assess emerging issues and determine which matters require immediate attention, which should continue as planned and which should be deferred.
Establish an effective working relationship with the CEO and serve as a trusted, pragmatic strategic adviser.
Support clear communication and collaboration across the executive team and broader organization.

Finance, Analytics and Executive Decision Support

Oversee budgeting, forecasting, cash management, financial reporting, audit readiness and core financial operations.
Ensure the continued integrity of financial systems, internal controls and risk-management practices.
Provide the CEO, executive team and Board committees with timely, relevant and decision-oriented financial analysis.
Strengthen the quality of management information by moving reporting beyond historical results toward clearer analysis of trends, risks, opportunities and forward-looking implications.
Improve the use of data, dashboards and analytics to support program, operational and resource-allocation decisions.
Ensure leaders receive appropriate support in developing and monitoring departmental and program budgets.
Maintain oversight of funder reporting, donor and partnership funds, charitable reporting requirements and other sector-specific financial obligations.

The underlying role is responsible for budgeting, financial analysis, monthly reporting, accounts payable and receivable, payroll, cash management, donor receipting, audit coordination and charitable-sector reporting.

Technology, AI and Cybersecurity

Provide executive oversight of the technology function and ensure that systems and services remain reliable, secure and aligned with organizational priorities.
Review the organization’s technology roadmap and identify immediate risks, dependencies and opportunities.
Help the CEO and executive team evaluate the responsible use of artificial intelligence, including where AI can improve productivity, analysis and service delivery while appropriately managing privacy, security and reputational risk.
Assess the organization’s cybersecurity and data-privacy posture, ensuring that material vulnerabilities and required actions are clearly understood by leadership.
Support the organization in prioritizing technology investments based on operational value, risk and available resources.
Ensure major technology initiatives are appropriately governed and positioned to deliver reliable performance and a positive user experience.
Strengthen the connection between finance, technology and organizational data so that leadership receives more integrated and actionable insights.

Team Leadership and Coaching

Lead a small, established team across finance and technology with empathy, clarity and consistency.
Preserve the strengths of a well-performing team while providing the direction and executive access needed during the transition.
Coach team members, clarify priorities and reinforce accountability without creating disruption or unnecessary organizational change.
Identify opportunities to strengthen capability, cross-functional collaboration and succession coverage.
Create an environment in which team members feel supported, informed and confident in raising concerns or escalating risks.
Provide the CEO with an objective assessment of team capacity, operating pressures and longer-term organizational needs.

Risk, Governance and Business Operations

Maintain effective financial, technology, privacy, legal and operational risk-management practices.
Ensure that material risks are identified, evaluated, documented and communicated to the CEO and the appropriate Board committee.
Support risk-register updates, insurance considerations, crisis-management readiness and business-continuity planning.
Ensure contracts and material commitments receive appropriate financial, operational and legal review.
Contribute to operational planning and help align organizational priorities, resources and budgets.
Prepare clear transition documentation and recommendations to support the eventual return or onboarding of permanent leadership.

Ideal Candidate Profile

The successful candidate will be an accomplished finance and business operations executive who has previously led both finance and technology portfolios. They will bring the maturity and judgment required to enter a stable team, establish credibility quickly and lead through a sensitive transition without overstepping the interim mandate.

Ideally, the candidate will offer:

Senior executive experience as a CFO, Vice President of Finance, Vice President of Corporate Services, or Vice President of Finance and Operations.
Demonstrated responsibility for both finance and information technology, either through direct leadership or an integrated corporate-services portfolio.
Experience working in a not-for-profit, charitable, membership-based, sport, healthcare, education or similar mission-driven environment.
Strong financial leadership capabilities encompassing budgeting, forecasting, financial reporting, audit, internal controls, cash management and executive decision support.
Experience improving management reporting, data analytics, business intelligence and organizational performance insights.
Meaningful exposure to cybersecurity, data privacy, technology governance and digital transformation.
A practical understanding of artificial intelligence and the governance considerations associated with its responsible organizational use.
Experience advising a CEO and presenting complex financial, operational and technology matters to executive teams and Board committees.
A collaborative, low-ego leadership style and demonstrated success coaching capable teams through periods of uncertainty or transition.
Discretion, diplomacy and emotional steadiness are required for a confidential leadership assignment.
A professional accounting designation would be strongly preferred.
Bilingualism would be considered an asset.

Leadership Style

This assignment will suit an interim executive who is:

Calm grounded and comfortable operating in ambiguity.
Strategic while remaining willing to engage directly in operational matters.
Respectful of the organization’s culture, history and existing team.
Able to distinguish between urgent stabilization needs and longer-term transformation opportunities.
Skilled at translating financial and technology complexity into clear executive-level advice.
Comfortable challenging constructively while remaining supportive of the CEO and leadership team.
Focused on leaving the organization, its systems and its people stronger at the conclusion of the mandate.

Measures of Success

Success over the three-to-six-month assignment will include:

Uninterrupted delivery of critical finance, technology and business operations.
A supported, engaged and well-directed finance and technology team.
Reliable financial reporting, forecasting, controls and audit readiness.
More decision-useful data, analytics and insights for the CEO and executive team.
Clearer prioritization of technology, AI, cybersecurity and data-privacy risks.
Sound and timely strategic advice to the CEO.
Effective management and escalation of organizational risks.
A disciplined transition plan, including documentation of key decisions, open issues and recommendations for longer-term leadership.

jobs.title: Vice President Finance
jobs.description:
Based in Burlington, Ontario, our client is a growing, market-leading North American manufacturer of welded aluminum and brass tubing for heat transfer applications across diverse industrial sectors. With a strong reputation for quality, reliability, and technical expertise, our client serves customers worldwide and provides dependable solutions for demanding, mission-critical applications.

We are seeking a hands-on and strategic Vice President, Finance to join its executive leadership team. This individual will oversee the organization’s financial strategy, planning, reporting, accounting, treasury, and risk management functions while providing clear financial insight to support sustainable growth and operational performance. The successful candidate will be a trusted business partner who is comfortable working across the organization and contributing to decisions that extend beyond traditional finance.

Responsibilities

Provide leadership for all financial operations, including financial reporting, budgeting, forecasting, treasury management, and long-range strategic planning.
Prepare and oversee timely monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements.
Partner with ownership and executive leadership to develop and execute financial strategies that support profitability, operational excellence, and sustainable growth.
Deliver meaningful financial analysis, variance reporting, and key performance indicators to support informed decision-making across the organization.
Lead the annual budgeting, forecasting, and strategic planning processes while monitoring financial performance against established objectives.
Oversee treasury functions, including cash flow management, working capital optimization, liquidity planning, foreign exchange exposure, and capital allocation.
Manage customs and duty-related activities, including U.S. duty reconciliations, customs compliance requirements, and annual customs bond renewals.
Lead the annual external audit process and manage relationships with auditors, financial institutions, legal advisors, tax authorities, and insurance providers.
Ensure compliance with all applicable tax, regulatory, insurance, and corporate governance requirements.
Oversee accounts receivable collections, accounts payable, payroll support, and day-to-day accounting operations.
Provide leadership and support to Human Resources, Reception, and Accounts Payable functions while contributing to broader administrative and office management activities.
Serve as the organization's ERP subject matter expert, supporting system optimization and cross-functional business processes.
Review contracts and provide financial and commercial input to support business decisions across all departments.
Participate as a key member of the leadership team by contributing to executive, ownership, operational, quality, and management review meetings.
Support information technology, telecommunications, and other operational initiatives through coordination with external service providers.
Perform additional duties as assigned while promoting a safe, organized, and compliant workplace.

Skills & Qualifications

CPA designation in good standing required.
Bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance, business administration, or a related discipline
10+ years of progressive finance and accounting experience, including senior leadership responsibility.
Proven experience in a manufacturing environment.
Strong knowledge of financial reporting, budgeting, forecasting, and financial planning and analysis (FP&A).
Demonstrated ability to develop and execute financial strategies that support growth, profitability, and long-term business objectives.
Experience leading annual audits and managing relationships with auditors, financial institutions, legal counsel, insurance providers, and regulatory authorities.
Strong treasury management experience, including cash flow forecasting, working capital management, foreign exchange, and banking relationships.
Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, with strong overall proficiency in the Microsoft Office Suite.
Strong business acumen with the ability to translate complex financial information into clear, actionable recommendations.
Excellent leadership, communication, and relationship management skills with the ability to influence stakeholders at all levels of the organization.
Ability to travel occasionally

Benefits

Competitive compensation package, including a base salary of $225,000 to $275,000 and participation in the management incentive plan.
Comprehensive Company-sponsored health benefits & retirement savings program
Potential participation in a Management Incentive Plan
A highly visible leadership role with broad organizational impact
The opportunity to combine strategic leadership with hands-on involvement in a dynamic manufacturing environment
A collaborative, entrepreneurial culture where ideas are valued and contributions are recognized

We are committed to creating an inclusive, accessible workplace in accordance with the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act (AODA). Accommodations are available upon request for candidates during all aspects of the recruitment and selection process. If you require accommodation, please contact us at dane.dsouza@mnp.ca to discuss your needs.

jobs.title: Director, Enterprise Data & Integration
jobs.description:
Build bold. Deliver impact. Win together.

At General Dynamics Mission Systems–Canada, we’re not just engineering technology — we’re shaping the future of defence and security. Our teams design and deliver advanced, mission-critical solutions that enhance national security, strengthen communities, and protect the people we serve.

If you’re looking for meaningful work that contributes to a safer, more secure world, you’ll find purpose here. Every day, your skills will directly impact programs that matter.

Job Description

Reporting to the Chief Digital and Information Officer (CDIO), the Director, Enterprise Data & Integration is responsible for establishing and maturing the organization's enterprise data capability. This includes developing the enterprise data strategy, architecture, governance framework, integration standards, and technology roadmap required to support operational excellence, analytics, reporting, artificial intelligence, and digital transformation.

The Director will help build and lead a small Data Engineering team and work across business and technology functions to transform fragmented, project-based data initiatives into a scalable, governed, and sustainable enterprise capability. This role is accountable for ensuring enterprise data is managed, integrated, and leveraged as a strategic asset across the organization.

Key Responsibilities

Enterprise Data Strategy & Capability Development

Develop and maintain the enterprise data strategy, roadmap, operating model, and target-state architecture aligned with business priorities.
Establish and mature enterprise data capabilities spanning architecture, governance, integration, engineering standards, and information management practices.
Partner with business and technology leaders to enable data-driven decision-making, analytics, automation, and AI readiness.

Data Architecture, Governance & Integration

Define and govern enterprise data architecture, integration architecture, information management standards, and reference models.
Establish scalable approaches for APIs, MuleSoft integration services, event-driven architecture, data pipelines, metadata, lineage, master/reference data, and data quality.
Ensure enterprise data solutions are secure, compliant, resilient, and aligned with enterprise architecture principles.

Platforms, Technology & Innovation

Provide strategic leadership for enterprise data platforms, integration technologies, analytics environments, and AI-enabling capabilities.
Evaluate technologies, vendors, and strategic investments to ensure alignment with business objectives, architecture standards, and long-term sustainability.
Drive modernization, simplification, and standardization across the enterprise data and integration landscape.

Leadership & Delivery Enablement

Provide technical leadership, mentorship, and direction to the Data Engineering team while fostering strong engineering and operational practices.
Support the planning, prioritization, and successful delivery of enterprise data and integration initiatives.
Build strong partnerships across business units, cybersecurity, infrastructure, applications, enterprise architecture, and external partners.

Governance & Continuous Improvement

Establish governance processes, architecture reviews, standards, and decision-making frameworks for enterprise data and integration solutions.
Identify and reduce technical debt, platform fragmentation, unmanaged data movement, and point-to-point integrations.
Promote reuse, consistency, and continuous improvement across enterprise data platforms, services, and integration capabilities.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Data Management, or a related discipline, or equivalent experience.
10+ years of experience in enterprise data architecture, integration architecture, data engineering, enterprise architecture, or related disciplines.
Demonstrated experience developing enterprise data strategies, governance frameworks, architecture standards, and technology roadmaps.
Experience leading technical teams and influencing senior business and technology stakeholders.
Strong understanding of enterprise data management, integration, governance, analytics, cloud platforms, security, and information management principles.
Experience working with or familiarity with AI/ML models

Preferred Qualifications

Experience designing and governing enterprise integration capabilities using MuleSoft Anypoint Platform
, including API-led connectivity, reusable integration services, event-driven architectures, and integration governance.
Experience with modern enterprise data platforms including Snowflake
, Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Factory, Synapse, Databricks, Purview, AWS data services, or comparable technologies.
Experience supporting enterprise analytics, reporting, AI/ML, automation, and digital transformation initiatives.
Familiarity with TOGAF, DAMA-DMBOK, COBIT, ITIL, or comparable architecture and governance frameworks.

It is a requirement that General Dynamics Mission Systems–Canada be registered with the Canadian Controlled Goods Program and that all of its workforce be security assessed. Successful applicants must meet all applicable security requirements, including but not limited to the ability to obtain and maintain a Canadian government security clearance. Applicants may be required to meet additional security requirements in order to gain access to technical data, classified areas, or information that is subject to international regulations. You must be eligible to work in Canada.

Additional Information

The hiring range for this position is $150,000-$200,000. This role is eligible for a management incentive plan. Our goal is to provide a fair and competitive offer based on an assessment of internal equity and your qualifications, including:

Relevant experience
Technical and non-technical skills
Education and certifications

Benefits

As a full-time employee at General Dynamics Mission Systems–Canada, you’ll enjoy a competitive total rewards package that supports your professional and personal well-being:

Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and eligible dependents from day one (no cost), including flexible benefits options (HCSA) emergency travel insurance, and 24/7 virtual care services.
Employee & Family Assistance Program (EFAP), onsite fitness facilities, and employee resource groups.
Defined Contribution Pension Plan with employer contributions after 3 months, RRSP access from day one, and financial planning support.
Flexible time off including vacation, holidays, parental leaves with top-up options, sick leave, and disability programs.
Career development through learning platforms, educational assistance, mentoring, and reimbursement of professional memberships.
Additional perks such as employee discounts, free onsite parking, social clubs, and an annual scholarship program for employees’ children.

Why join us?

Purposeful Innovation:
You’ll work on innovations that genuinely make a difference. You’ll apply advanced thinking, design expertise, and practical problem-solving to help equip military and allied forces with leading-edge systems. You’ll be surrounded by some of the brightest minds in the defence sector, contributing to next-generation technologies in an environment that celebrates creativity, new ideas, and modern solutions.
Connection:
We believe people do their best work when they feel they belong, and their ideas can flourish. Different perspectives, experiences, and ways of thinking help us innovate and grow. Strong relationships with our teammates help us unite, overcome challenges, and deliver the world-class quality we’re known for. Here, we are committed to inclusivity and ensures every individual feels valued, respected, and empowered.
Challenging and Rewarding Career Pathways:
Your career path matters to us. From mentorship and regular check-ins with your leader to educational support, professional certifications, and continuous training, you’ll have the resources you need to thrive. We encourage internal mobility so you can explore different business areas, broaden your skillset, and expand your network. You’ll be working on high-profile, impactful projects that challenge your skills, expand your expertise, and allow you to both learn from mentors and guide others along the way.

Accommodation

If you require accommodation during any stage of the application process, please contact Human Resources via recruitment@gd-ms.ca.

Closing Date

We reserve the right to close this vacancy early if we receive sufficient applications for the role. Therefore, if you are interested, please submit your application as early as possible.

jobs.title: Director, Application Development - Customer Digital
jobs.description:
Being part of Air Canada is to become part of an iconic Canadian symbol, recently ranked the best Airline in North America. Let your career take flight by joining our diverse and vibrant team at the leading edge of passenger aviation.

The Director of Application Development will lead the design, development, and delivery of some of our most critical customer digital applications and all our in-house cargo applications. Its customer application portfolio consists of aircanada.com’s content related applications (Content Management System (CMS) platform, Homepage), marketing digital assets (Offer Management, DNA) as well as Customer Identity and Access Management (CIAM). Its cargo portfolio includes the cargo website (informational and transactional), the cargo distribution API, the cargo digital backend and all the cargo integrations, a portfolio that keeps growing with the new Cargo Management System implementation through the end of 2028.

This role will also be responsible for the Delivery COE and the Innovation COE for all the customer and cargo portfolios. The Delivery COE aims at harmonizing the delivery practice, KPIs, continuous improvements within the portfolio. The Innovation COE aims at improving our digital technology platforms, through continuous improvements (i.e., progressive AI adoption, Continuous Integration /Continuous Development (CI/CD) pipeline enhancements, etc) as well as disruptive innovations through POCs and partnership with Air Canada’s key technology vendors (i.e., transition to Mono Repo, introduction of a new Model Context Protocol (MCP) stack, etc.). This role is key to our digital transformation journey and will be pivotal in empowering the IDD organization to achieve its cost transformation and innovation goals.

This role will also focus on people leadership, including talent acquisition, training, performance management, and fostering a high-performing team culture.

Responsibilities

Leadership & Strategy
Provide strategic and hands-on leadership for teams building the future marketing and content technology landscape for Air Canada
Lead the cargo deliver teams towards a successful implementation of the new Cargo Management System.
Deliver disruptive technology driven innovations that dramatically increase revenue or reduce cost.
Drive the insourcing strategy by recruiting, developing, and retaining top engineering talent, reducing reliance on vendor-driven delivery models.
Collaborate with Product Owners, UX/UI Designers, and Architects to define the product vision, architecture, and development roadmap.

Technology & Innovation
Oversee the delivery of robust, scalable, and secure digital applications, with a focus on performance, user experience, and maintainability.
Ensure modern engineering practices are followed, including Agile delivery, CI/CD automation, DevSecOps, test automation, and shift-left testing.
Champion the use and integration of Generative AI tooling and AI Agents within the development lifecycle to increase developer productivity and enable rapid iteration.
Stay ahead of emerging technologies and assess their relevance and value for digital product development.
Foster a culture of engineering excellence through code quality, design standards, peer reviews, and continuous learning.

Execution & Delivery
Own end-to-end product delivery, from development through production deployment and support.
Collaborate closely with internal product managers, designers, architects, and quality assurance teams to ensure timely and high-quality product releases.
Monitor team performance, manage risks, remove delivery blockers, and drive accountability for outcomes.
Ensure proper technical documentation and knowledge-sharing across teams.

Collaboration & Communication
Partner cross-functionally with other IT and Digital leaders, including Architecture, Security, Data, and Infrastructure teams.
Engage with key business stakeholders across Digital, Marketing, Loyalty, and HR to ensure alignment between product features and business priorities.
Present technical strategies and delivery progress to senior leadership, contributing to enterprise-wide technology planning.

People & Budget Management
Manage operational and capital budgets, ensuring efficient resource allocation and delivery within financial targets.
Develop and maintain staffing plans, forecast resource needs, and align capacity to strategic priorities.
Support training and professional development programs to grow technical capabilities within the team.
Establish performance metrics and continuous improvement practices for team delivery and application performance.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field; equivalent experience may be considered in lieu of formal education.
10+ years of experience in digital application development, with at least 5 years in a leadership role managing front-end and back-end development teams.
Proven success in leading digital transformations, including insourcing and adoption of modern development frameworks and practices.
Deep technical expertise in web and mobile application development, microservices, cloud-native architecture, and API ecosystems.
Experience integrating AI/ML technologies or Generative AI into product development lifecycles is a strong asset.
Strong understanding of Agile, DevOps, and CI/CD best practices.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence across both business and technology teams.
Experience working in or with enterprise-scale organizations, ideally in travel, transportation, or customer experience-driven industries.
Demonstrate punctuality and dependability to support overall team success in a fast-paced environment.

Conditions Of Employment

Candidates must be eligible to work in the country of interest at the time any offer of employment is made and are responsible for obtaining any required work permits, visas, or other authorizations necessary for employment. Prior to their start date, candidates will also need to provide proof of their eligibility to work in the country of interest.

Linguistic Requirements

Based on equal qualifications, preference will be given to bilingual candidates.

We’re at the beginning of the journey. There is no existing tech team or finished platform. This is an opportunity to help define what we build, how we build it, and the technical foundations of the company.

Building our software architecture, databases, and core technology.
Developing digital experiences for farmers and corporate buyers.
Building our website and, over time, additional applications and tools.
Helping define our technical roadmap, priorities, and long-term infrastructure.

Second-, third-, and fourth-year university engineering or computer science students.
Recent graduates and early-career software developers.

You'll be responsible for the development, execution, and evolution of The Now Agency's YouTube offering, spanning client strategy, delivery excellence, team development, operational infrastructure, and commercial growth.

jobs.title: Director of Finance
jobs.description:
Springer Group of Companies is a well‑established, family‑owned real estate investment and development organization based in Kingston, Ontario. The organization manages a diverse portfolio of assets and operates with a long‑term, hands‑on ownership approach, emphasizing financial discipline, operational efficiency, and sustainable growth.

Reporting directly to ownership, the Director of Finance will oversee the full accounting function and play a key role in maintaining the financial health of the organization. This position is responsible for financial reporting, payroll, tax compliance, cash management, and team leadership, while working closely with external advisors to support ongoing operations and strategic initiatives.

Responsibilities

Oversee monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reporting across multiple entities.
Prepare and review quarterly financial statements and support year‑end accounting processes.
Maintain general ledger integrity, intercompany balances, and corporate records.
Manage corporate tax filings including T2s, T3s, T5s, and partnership returns, as well as quarterly tax installments.
Oversee HST, EHT, WSIB reporting and annual reconciliations.
Act as the primary point of contact for CRA correspondence, audits, and notices of assessment.
Oversee bi‑monthly payroll processing, including T4s, ROEs, employee remittances, and garnishments.
Manage employee onboarding and offboarding, payroll changes, benefits administration, and employee records.
Approve online payments, electronic workflows, and daily cheque runs.
Manage banking relationships, financing renewals, lender reporting, and cash management activities.
Track and administer GICs, mortgages, and other financing instruments.
Lead and delegate work across the accounting team, including daily prioritization and workload planning.
Maintain an accurate organizational chart and support team development initiatives.
Manage accounting systems and tools, including Yardi and related subscriptions.
Liaise with external partners including accountants, lawyers, auditors, banks, and property development partners.
Provide financial analysis, reporting, and ad hoc insights to ownership as required.

Skills & Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
CPA designation required.
Minimum five (5) years of progressive accounting or finance experience; real estate or multi‑entity experience is an asset.
Strong knowledge of financial reporting, payroll, and corporate tax compliance.
Experience managing multiple deadlines and working with external advisors.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office; experience with Yardi or similar systems is an asset.
Strong organizational skills and the ability to work independently in an owner‑led environment.

Benefits

Competitive base salary.
Paid time off.
Extended health, dental, and vision coverage.
Life insurance.
On‑site parking.

We are committed to creating an inclusive, accessible workplace in accordance with the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act (AODA). Accommodations are available upon request for candidates during all aspects of the recruitment and selection process. If you require accommodation, please contact us at felicia.scaviarupi@mnp.ca to discuss your needs.

Description

Discover Hotel PUR, Quebec, a Tribute Portfolio Hotel, where bold design, local spirit and modern hospitality come together in the heart of Quebec City’s vibrant Saint-Roch district. With striking city views, distinctive spaces, locally inspired dining, a heated indoor pool and a neighborhood filled with art, culture, boutiques and celebrated restaurants, Hotel PUR offers guests an experience that is anything but ordinary. For hospitality professionals, it’s an opportunity to be part of a dynamic, design-forward property where the energy of Quebec City is woven into every guest experience.

The Director of Finance is responsible for providing ethical and consistent leadership in the financial area of the hotel by supplying management with guidance, training and support. The Director of Finance is also responsible for focusing on the profitability of the business, maintaining accurate and timely financial reporting, ensuring acceptable levels of internal controls, ensuring compliance with all federal, state, and local regulations, and safeguarding owners/investors assets.

Responsibilities

Financial:

Acts as the “Chief Business Officer” to the general manager and EC Team, and as such is responsible for evaluating the financial impact on business decisions.
Ensure that all levels of management are promptly notified of any financial deviations from established policies and/or control weaknesses in the hotel.
Effectively manage and communicate cash flow related issues, as required to management and ownership. This includes the accurate and timely preparation of cash-flow statements, management of receivables, cash balances, control mechanisms and timely deposits of all funds.
Monitor hotel revenues and expenses and ensure the accurate recording in accordance with Crescent Hotels & Resorts established guidelines. Investigate and critique variances to budget or to prior year and offer practical improvement strategies to management.
Monitor the capital planning process by assisting management with calculation of return on capital improvements, gathering support and monitoring the bid process, and evaluating scope of work and specifications.
Ensure Hotels’ compliance on all regulatory licenses and permits, leases, contracts, legal agreements, and the proper execution of all operational taxes. Provide assistance to management in enforcing compliance on all these items.
Coordinate the completion of all forecasts and budgets as required, with the full and active participation of EC Team and department managers.
Analyze financial data and operations in order to assist and advise management in maintaining the Hotels’ financial objectives.
Ensure that all balance sheet accounts, including bank reconciliations are reconciled on a timely basis.
Establish and continually audit all internal financial controls including purchasing, cash handling, disbursements, credit extension, inventories, hotel assets, master keys, payroll, and employee records.
Embrace a continuous growth environment by actively hiring professional staff and assisting in recruiting, reviewing, recommending and maintaining an inventory of qualified and promotable Associates that can potentially become Directors of Finance, Assistant Directors of Finance, Accounting Managers, and other managers for the organization.
Continually focus on training and development programs for finance associates to cultivate the “brightest” and “best” talent within the industry.
Hire, train, supervise and develop staff, including coaching, counseling and discipline.
Maintain compliance with Crescent Hotels & Resorts standards and regulations to ensure safe and efficient operation of the hotel.
Ensure proper utilization, maintenance and periodic upgrades of all IT systems and equipments.
Direct and/or prepare all financial reports in accordance with Crescent Hotels & Resorts requirements meeting various due dates and deadlines:
Ensure and monitor that the hotel is in compliance with all report deadlines and due dates and react accordingly.
Maximize efforts towards productivity, identify problem areas and assist in finding and implementing their solutions.
Approach all encounters with guests and employees in an attentive, friendly, courteous and service-oriented manner.
Maintain regular attendance in compliance with Crescent Hotels & Resorts standards, as required by scheduling which will vary according to the needs of the hotel.
Maintain high standards of personal appearance and grooming, which include wearing the professional attire and nametag when working.
Comply at all times with Crescent Hotels & Resorts standards and regulations to encourage safe and efficient hotel operations.

QUALIFICATION STANDARDS

Education & Experience

A minimum of 8 years of related progressive experience in hotel Accounting or related field; or a 4-year college degree with an Accounting/Finance concentration and a minimum of 4 years of related progressive experience; or a 2-year college degree and a minimum of 6 years of related progressive experience.
Must be fluent in both written and spoken English and French.

Job Description

What is the opportunity?

As Director, Corporate Client Group Finance (CCGF), you are part of the mid-market Corporate Banking team and play a key role in the realization of Corporate Client Group (CCG) objectives through the structuring, delivery and management of the bank debt of a targeted customer base. We target loan origination in the Canadian mid-market, including large Canadian subsidiaries of foreign multinationals, private and small cap public Canadian companies, and are responsible for meeting annually established targets for loan derived revenues and returns by providing advice to our partners on optimizing the use of lending in connection with broader RBC relationship goals.

What will you do?

Support CCG relationship managers to structure, deliver, close, and monitor loan transactions under direction of the Senior Director CCG Finance, including credit submissions and transaction presentations
Support CCG relationship managers in the preparation and presentation of marketing pitches to existing and potential clients
Follow up and engage with RBC partners and functions including Group Risk Management, Private Banking, RBC Investments, Capital Markets, specialized teams in Commercial Financial Services (leasing, trade finance etc.), Personal Banking, and others
Work with Group Risk Management to ensure proper alignment with credit processes and client expectations Provide research, analysis, and data (market, industry, client, and competitor) to support CCG advice on the optimal amount of bank debt required to meet strategic objectives with each client relationship
Take part in the national team of CCG Finance underwriters committed to the delivery of quality credit products to RBC clients and targets
Provide analysis and support to Senior Director CCG Finance and CCG Finance colleagues for advice on risk and return associated with loan transactions contemplated as part of client strategies

What do you need to succeed?

Must-have

Undergraduate degree in Business, Economics, Accounting, or Finance
Strong quantitative, financial modeling, and analytical skills with an ability to analyze company financial statements
Knowledge of credit, credit metrics, credit structuring and the capability to work through Loan Agreements and other legal documents
Advanced skills with Excel, Word, PowerPoint and the ability to source data/research
Professional oral and written communication skills with a high level of attention to detail in both written and financial work
Ability to perform well under pressure, meet time sensitive deadlines, prioritize work and multi-task responsibilities while working on multiple projects
Well organized and able to set priorities and devote appropriate attention to each assignment

Nice-to-have

MBA, CPA or CFA
Work experience in corporate lending/corporate finance
Trained in credit and accounting with an ability to manage complex concepts

We thrive on the challenge to be our best, progressive thinking to keep growing, and working together to deliver trusted advice to help our clients thrive and communities prosper. Ability to make a difference and lasting impact

Opportunities to do challenging work

Commercial Credit Underwriting, Commercial Loan Underwriting, Credit Structuring, Financial Statement Analysis
